payload.rebuttal: fixed: The refusal witness only ever passed a mismatching `--repo`, so nothing in it proved that a matching repo given as a relative path is accepted. A mutant comparing `args.repo` (unresolved) instead of the resolved `repo` would wrongly refuse every relative `--repo`, matching or not, and nothing caught that, since the only relative-path case lived in the other witness. I added a case to the refusal test that chdirs to the repo's parent, passes a relative `--repo` resolving to the file's own repo, and asserts the command is not refused (exit 0, no refusal line, `run_stack_batch` called once). Verified by hand: applying the exact mutant now fails both witnesses; reverted before committing.
